guide.intro: EPUB is the open e-book format used by Apple Books, Google Play Books, Kobo and libraries. {brand}'s reader opens it directly in your browser – on a Chromebook, a work PC or a phone – with the book's own styles, images and table of contents, and nothing to install.
uses: Read a DRM-free e-book on a computer without installing an app.
Preview an EPUB you created before publishing it.
Open MOBI or FB2 books on any device.
Check a book's contents and images quickly.
tips: Use night mode for reading in the dark.
Increase the text size on small screens.
Download the converted EPUB for MOBI/FB2 books to keep it in your library app.
more: How it works

The EPUB (a ZIP of XHTML chapters) is unpacked in memory. The package file gives the reading order and the navigation document or NCX gives the table of contents; images, styles and fonts are served from temporary local URLs so the chapters look as the publisher intended.
